title: dedicated-capacity-weekly-prep-maya-patel-2026-03-04
content:
Weekly prep notes for dedicated capacity sync - March 4, 2026

Purpose:
- Prep for weekly dedicated-capacity sync. Focus: short-term GPU pool forecast, upcoming reservation renewals, autoscaling tuning, and open action items for Dedicated ops.

Quick summary / TL;DR:
- Usage trending up: customer commit consumption increased ~12% week-over-week (mainly from a large recommender customer switching to H100s).
- Short-term demand spike expected for 2026-03-10 -> 2026-03-20 window due to demo season + one-time large training-like inference workload from RetailCo.
- We have ~48 H100 slots available unreserved across eu-west-1 and us-west-2; recommend holding 24 as buffer and offering 24 as short-term burst via autoscaling policy.
- Reservation renewals: two mid-size customers (ACME Media, FinFlow) have renewals on 2026-03-15; need to confirm committed GPU counts.

Current pool snapshot (as of 2026-03-04):
- Total Dedicated GPUs (logical slots): 420
  - H100 80GB: 160 (reserved: 112, unreserved: 48)
  - A100 40GB: 200 (reserved: 178, unreserved: 22)
  - T4/E5 equivalent: 60 (reserved: 50, unreserved: 10)
- On-demand (burst) capacity configured: 120 logical slots across regions (cost-optimized).
- Typical autoscale buffer (safety pool): 10% of reserved capacity by default; for H100 this equates to ~11 slots but we are recommending temporarily increasing to 15% for demo window.

Forecast assumptions and drivers:
- RetailCo spike: expected sustained 300 qps at 1.2s p95 for 4 hours/day for 10 days -> equivalent of ~18 H100 slots if run without batching. With recommended batching (batch=8, latency target 2s) reduces to ~6 slots.
- Recommender customer migration: currently moving from A100 to H100 (phased). Phase 1 (complete) increased H100 usage by ~32 slots. Phase 2 (planned for late March) may add another ~28 slots.
- New trial customers onboarding this month: expect 6 small trials (~2-4 GPUs each) over next 2 weeks.

Recommendations for this week:
1) Reservation confirmations (urgent): ping ACME Media and FinFlow to confirm whether they will renew or downsize their commitments. If ACME reduces by >8 GPUs, we can reallocate to demo window. (Action: Maya to send renewal confirmation emails by 2026-03-05)
2) Autoscaling policy tweak (short-term): increase H100 safety buffer from 10% -> 15% from 2026-03-09 through 2026-03-21. Also temporarily allow burst-to-unreserved up to +30% for customers with burst-enabled plans. (Action: Jordan to propose config delta and deploy by 2026-03-06)
3) Batching guidance to RetailCo (cost saving): recommend SDK change to enable dynamic batching with batch_size=8 and latency SLO 2s to reduce slot needs. (Action: Ryan to point RetailCo to batching example + sample config by 2026-03-05)
4) Short-term offers: create a one-off 'demo pool' package (24 H100 slots) priced with 20% premium for guaranteed availability during 2026-03-10..2026-03-20, marketing to field success contacts. (Action: Hannah to draft offer + pricing + legal template by 2026-03-06)

Open questions / risks:
- If ACME and FinFlow both renew at current levels, buffer for demo window drops below recommended levels unless we reassign A100 -> H100 via migration (costly and risky).
- Autoscaling latency spikes: increasing burst caps risks p95 degradation for lower-tier customers. Need SRE signoff.
- Billing/pricing: one-off demo pool needs clear billing process to avoid invoicing disputes. Legal review required.

Data / metrics to surface in sync (what to show in dashboard):
- 7d / 30d reserved utilization by GPU type (H100, A100, T4).
- Active reservation queue lengths and pending onboarding requests.
- Projected utilization for 2026-03-10..2026-03-20 under current policies vs with recommended autoscale/batching changes.
- Cost impact estimate (delta $/hr) for moving 24 H100s to demo pool vs transient burst.

Meeting agenda (15 min):
- 0:00-0:02 quick TL;DR (Maya)
- 0:02-0:06 Confirm reservation renewals + immediate reassign options (Maya, Jordan)
- 0:06-0:09 Autoscaling buffer change proposal + SRE signoff timeline (Jordan)
- 0:09-0:12 RetailCo batching and onboarding support (Ryan)
- 0:12-0:15 Demo pool offer and billing/legal check (Hannah)

Notes to self (scratchpoints):
- When pinging ACME, attach utilization snapshot and projected chairs to justify reallocations.
- Check whether any dedicated private customers have hard affinity to physical hosts preventing quick H100 reassignments (ask infra).
- If RetailCo insists on lower latency than 2s, build quick POC on lower-batch strategy and estimate cost.

Follow-ups (compact list):
- Maya: email ACME + FinFlow renewals (due 2026-03-05)
- Jordan: autoscale config PR + SRE review (due 2026-03-06) -> PR link to add in weekly notes once created
- Ryan: RetailCo batching example + quick SDK snippet (due 2026-03-05)
- Hannah: draft demo-pool pricing + legal template (due 2026-03-06)
- Maya: prepare dashboard screenshots (utilization by GPU type + projection) for meeting (due 2026-03-04 end of day)

Quick scratch metrics exported from internal query (paste for meeting):
- H100 reserved utilization (7d avg): 78%
- H100 reserved utilization (30d avg): 72%
- A100 reserved utilization (7d avg): 89%
- Pending onboarding requests: 9 (3 requested H100)
- Renewals due next 7 days: 4 accounts (ACME, FinFlow, BrightAd, MedAI)

Misc notes / fragments to keep: 
- Consider temporary cross-region borrow: move eu-west-1 unreserved H100s to us-west-2 queue for demo if network costs acceptable. Need infra feasibility.
- Long-term: propose auto-reserve feature for demo windows (customers can pre-pay to guarantee capacity) -> product idea for next quarter roadmap discussion.

End of notes.
